events.name: Columbus Blue Jackets at Buffalo Sabres

headlines.description: — Rookie Colten Ellis stopped 37 shots for his first NHL career shutout, and the Buffalo Sabres beat Columbus 5-0 to dent the Blue Jackets’ playoff chances on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Colten Ellis stops 37 shots for first NHL career shutout in Sabres 5-0 win over Blue Jackets

events.name: Tampa Bay Lightning at Montreal Canadiens

headlines.shortLinkText: Caufield scores 50th goal, Slafkovsky nets the winner as the Canadiens beat the Lightning 2-1

headlines.description: — Fabian Zetterlund scored a pair of goals and the Ottawa Senators moved closer to securing a playoff berth with a 5-1 win over the Florida Panthers on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fabian Zetterlund scores twice as Senators move closer to playoffs, beating Panthers 5-1

events.name: Philadelphia Flyers at Detroit Red Wings

headlines.description: — Dylan Larkin had three goals and an assist as the Detroit Red Wings kept their playoff chances alive with a 6-3 win over the Philadelphia Flyers on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Larkin's hat trick, Seider's career night lead Red Wings to crucial win over Flyers, 6-2

events.name: Pittsburgh Penguins at New Jersey Devils

headlines.description: — Evgeni Malkin scored as part of his two-point game, Sidney Crosby set up two goals and Kris Letang had an assist as the Pittsburgh Penguins clinched a playoff spot by defeating the New Jersey Devils 5-2 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Malkin, Crosby and Letang help the Penguins beat the Devils to clinch a playoff spot

events.name: Winnipeg Jets at St. Louis Blues

headlines.description: — Alex Iafallo, Josh Morrissey and Jonathan Toews scored as the Winnipeg Jets beat the St. Louis Blues 3-2 Thursday night, keeping their playoff hopes alive.
headlines.shortLinkText: Iafallo, Morrissey and Toews score as the Jets beat the Blues 3-2 to keep playoff hopes alive

headlines.description: — Logan Stankoven had two goals and an assist, helping the depleted Carolina Hurricanes beat the Chicago Blackhawks 7-2 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stankoven, Jankowski score twice as the Hurricanes rout the Blackhawks 7-2

headlines.shortLinkText: Robertson's 42nd goal lifts Stars over Wild in a preview before their 1st-round playoff series

headlines.description: — Nathan MacKinnon scored his career-high 52nd goal of the season into an empty net and had two assists to help the Colorado Avalanche clinch the NHL's top seed for the postseason with a 3-1 win over the...
headlines.shortLinkText: MacKinnon scores career-high 52nd goal of season, Avs clinch NHL's top seed with 3-1 win over Flames

headlines.description: — Dylan Guenther scored his 39th goal of the season, Clayton Keller had three assists to reach 56 and the Utah Mammoth beat the Nashville Predators 4-1 on Thursday night for their fifth straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mammoth beat the Predators 4-1 for 5th straight win and then secure playoff berth in 2nd season

events.name: San Jose Sharks at Anaheim Ducks

headlines.description: — John Carlson scored three goals for the first hat trick of his 17-year NHL career, and the Anaheim Ducks snapped their six-game losing streak with an emphatic 6-1 victory over the San Jose Sharks on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: John Carlson's 1st hat trick in a 17-year career sends Ducks past Sharks 6-1, snaps 6-game skid

events.name: Vegas Golden Knights at Seattle Kraken

headlines.description: — Berkly Catton scored in the third period and added a game-winner in the shootout as the Seattle Kraken ended a six-game losing streak with a 4-3 victory over the Vegas Golden Knights on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Catton scores game-winner in shootout, Kraken end skid with 4-3 victory against Golden Knights

events.name: Vancouver Canucks at Los Angeles Kings

headlines.description: — Adrian Kempe had two goals, and the Los Angeles Kings moved into a playoff spot with a 4-1 win over the Vancouver Canucks on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Adrian Kempe scores twice, Kings top Canucks 4-1 to move back into Western Conference wild card spot
